entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is very important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, David, I need to return this helmet I bought. This whole process is a joke and I want my money back NOW.
I can certainly look into that return for you. To get started, may I have your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
It's under angrycustomer@email.com. And let me be clear, if I don't get a return label by the end of this call, I'm lighting you up on every review site on the internet. This is unacceptable.

I understand your frustration, and I'll do everything I can to resolve this for you right now. Thank you for that email, I'm pulling up your account... Okay, I see the Trail Helmet purchased 13 days ago. Can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

It's a preference! The color is hideous, it looks nothing like the picture online. I wouldn't trust my safety to a helmet from a company that can't even get a simple color right. The box is still unopened! I haven't even touched it. I want a refund. Are you going to help me or do I need to speak to your manager?

That won't be necessary, I can absolutely handle this for you. I completely understand wanting the product to match your expectations. Let me just quickly check our return guidelines for you... Okay, I've confirmed it. Your purchase is well within our 90-day return window, so I can process this for a full refund immediately.
Wait, really? Just like that? You're not going to give me a hard time?

Not at all. I've just authorized the return in our system. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email on file right now. You should see it in the next couple of minutes. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off at any shipping center.
Oh. Okay then. Well... that's better than I expected.

I also see that you're a VIP member with us, and we truly value your business. For the inconvenience with the helmet color, I've gone ahead and added a $25 VeloFit credit to your account. You can use that on any future purchase with us.
Wow, a credit too? Okay, David, that's... that's actually really good service. I appreciate you taking care of that so quickly. Thank you.
You are very welcome. We want to make sure you're happy. Once we receive the helmet back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks again for your help.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
